about: What a survival world starts with when the host picks Survival in the lobby (docs/sandbox/CONSTRUCTS.md, 'Creative or Survival'): blueprint or part names, each placed on clear, level ground near the parts rack. Only what the world can't make for itself: without these nothing can make a Drill Module, a Saw Module, a Smelter, a Sawmill, a Foundry, a Press, an Extruder, a Bake Oven or a Building Station, and tier 1 can't make a genset. Since the Assembler retired (2026-11-28) a Press and its dies press the small parts, an Extruder and a Bake Oven (with a Building Station for kits of more than one piece) make the placed ones, and the Assembler builds only the hand-held items no die presses yet and the giant parts no oven holds. A map's sandbox section may replace the list with 'survivalStart'.
